Node.js 24 was released on May 6, 2025. A Japanese news report says it came out that day and is free to download from nodejs.org (index 3-1). LogRocket also gives May 6, 2025 as the official launch date (index 1-1).

The release was initially "Current." Clever Cloud notes that it was set to become LTS in October 2025 and would be supported until April 2028 (index 7-1, 7-2). Node.js 24.0 is the first release. Turbo.net lists 24.1 as dated May 22, 2025, and 24.3 as June 25, 2025 (index 4-2, 6-2).
